# Synthetic validator contract vectors

coding-instructions-3-matrix.json is the non-live synthetic conformance matrix from
a2-open-presence/contract/examples/coding-v0.4-instructions-3-matrix.json. It is
validator supporting test data covered by the selected Area2 component inclusion
authorized on31October2026, under Apache-2.0. It contains no captured typing or
private Capsule readings. Tests temporarily mark cloned vectors production only
inside an offline function call; no vector is sent to OP or a model.
